eip8141_frames_status.highlight: EIP-8141 CFI'd for Hegota; devnet-zero in progress; question is whether to elevate to headliner
Recent 8141 changes: Glamsterdam integration (2D gas, state gas as explicit second dimension), spec clarifications; signature list unchanged since May
ethrex has two live testnets: privacy-only (Frames + FOCIL + recent roots) and Hegota-like playground (post-tx assertions, native UTXOs)

eip8130_proposal.highlight: EIP-8130 launching on Base (late September); OP Stack and Arbitrum also committing; decoupled authenticator-based account model
8130 thesis: no capability gap vs. 8141, but lower cost; 8141's coupled account model is the core objection
Key 8130 advantage: authenticator declared top-level in tx — dependencies inspectable without tracing; enables permissionless payer innovation
Conceded 8130 gap: cannot support post-execution gas payment (e.g., pay with ETH acquired during execution); 8141 supports this

technical_debate.highlight: Felix (Geth): pure-function authenticators reduce DOS risk, but recent roots requires storage and cannot be truly pure
Nicolas (cryptography): 8141 STARK aggregation of hash-based sigs is the L1 scaling path; enshrined 8130 authenticator set creates permanent governance burden as PQ landscape shifts
Tsahi (Offchain Labs): 8130 authenticator-as-contract-address avoids coordination overhead for new signature schemes; wants 8141 to adopt this extensibility

convergence_discussion.highlight: Nethermind: L1 should not enshrine any specific account model; generic primitives preferred, adapters choose their model
lightclient: no client team supports 8130 as-is on L1; proposal to draft a companion EIP adding keystore to 8141 as the path forward
Felix (Geth): keystore companion EIP for 8141 could enable account portability and satisfy L2 interop without enshrining full 8130 actor model

action_items.action: Draft companion EIP adding keystore concept to EIP-8141 for cross-team review
Base/8130 team to sync with L1 core devs before shipping 8130; commit to collab window before September fork

decisions.decision: Default path confirmed: EIP-8141 proceeds on L1; EIP-8130 proceeds on L2s (Base, OP Stack, Arbitrum); convergence to be attempted in a timeboxed collab session
No client team supports adopting EIP-8130 as-is on L1; enshrined keystore/actor model considered out of scope for L1 protocol

targets.target: EIP-8130 launch on Base — late September 2026
